messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate on infer-prod (us-west-2) gateway. 15m avg = 6.2% (SLO target <0.5%). Spike started ~3332100000. Possible runtime crashes on model-runner.

jamie: paging oncall @alice — please join. 502s + timeouts reported, some customers affected.

alice: I'm on it, joining now. seeing gateway 502/504 from route /v1/generate. rolling alerts show correlated node restarts in model-runner pool 'runner-quant-1'.

devon: grabbing logs from pod runner-quant-1-7b: `kubectl -n inference logs runner-quant-1-7b --since=15m` — getting segfault/oom lines, attaching tail.

devon: ```
[2026-03-17T18:12:04Z] model-runner: segfault at 0x0
[2026-03-17T18:12:04Z] runtime: kalloc failure: can't allocate 2.1G
stack: ...
kernel: cm->quant_kernel_apply+0x1f
``` 

maria: this looks like the quantized attention kernel hitting an OOM path when KV cache grows. recent rollout: model-runner v1.4.2 + quant-kernel v0.9 enabled on this pool.

alice: immediate mitigation: 1) route traffic away from runner-quant-1 pool -> add-route fallback to runner-fp16-1, 2) scale-up runner-fp16-1 by +4 replicas, 3) drain affected nodes, 4) disable quant-kernel via deploy flag. doing step 1 now.

deploy-bot: route update submitted: traffic_rules: infer-prod -> prefer runner-fp16-1 (weight 85%), fallback to runner-legacy (weight 15%). change_id=chg-33321-01

alice: step 1 done. error rate dropped from 6% -> 1.2% in 3m, latency improved. still seeing occasional 502s from in-flight sessions.

jamie: notifying CS: `@carla-cs` please ping enterprise customers on long-polling jobs. AcmeRetail reported 100 failed inference calls over last 20m.

carla-cs: pinged AcmeRetail and created support ticket INC-7842. They confirm retries are failing for batch night jobs. We'll offer retry window and temporary route to dedicated capacity.

devon: attempting hotfix: rolling restart model-runner pods with env VAR `QUANT_KERNEL_ENABLED=false` on runner-quant-1 pool. `kubectl set env ds/runner-quant QUANT_KERNEL_ENABLED=false -n inference` then restart.

ops-bot: restart jobs queued: 7 pods rolling restart initiated on runner-quant-1 pool (start=3332100200)

maria: while restarts happen, let's turn on extra autoscaling cushion for fp16 pool: `autoscaler set --pool runner-fp16-1 --min 6` to absorb traffic.

alice: confirmed restarts completed; the segfault trace no longer appears. 5xx is down to 0.3% steady. marking immediate customer impact mitigated.

jamie: oncall handoff: @alice will stay as primary for next 45m to monitor. I'll prepare post-mortem notes and file initial RCA.

alice: logs and core dumps archived to s3://redwood-incident-archives/3332100123/ — core files from runner-quant-1-7b included. Posting short stacktrace to incident board.

maria: root cause hypothesis: quant-kernel memory accounting regression in v0.9 combined with unbounded KV cache growth for certain long-context customers. next steps: 1) revert quant-kernel rollout on production pools, 2) add KV cache circuit-breaker cap per request, 3) add OOM guard in runtime to return 429 instead of crash, 4) scheduled canary tests with long-context workloads.

alice: agreed. opening follow-up tasks in infra backlog and tagging owners. I'll hand off to the oncall rotation at 3332100380. leaving monitoring alerts lowered but keeping page policy for 1hr.

jamie: thanks all. Summary to execs + CS in 30m. We'll follow up with timeline and remediation plan. :thumbsup:
